comment: Pinned tools for the content pipeline (spec 009, task T-002). Anything not pinned here is not used by a gate.

encoderFlags.comment: -m 0 writes the full mip chain; -vflip stores top-down (sources are authored top-down, so the engine samples without a V flip); -nogpu forces the deterministic CPU path so package hashes do not depend on the GPU; -dx10 emits the DX10 extended header that the verifier parses; -y overwrites an existing output. Only colour channels use -srgb; normal/roughness/metalness/ao are authored data and must not be linearised (`-srgbi` was wrongly applied until 2026-10-30, storing 0.5 as 0.214 and decoding every normal with a ~54 deg tilt).

python.status: pinned by content/tools/requirements-content.txt (Pillow==12.3.0); the observed version on the authoring host is recorded here and every package records the versions it actually used
